name: AIZO
recent: AIZO Group Berhad 近期完成可赎回可转换优先股（ICPS）到期自动转换，并因雇员认股计划（ESOS）发行新股。公司将于2026年11月24日召开第24届常年股东大会，同时一名独立非执行董事在闭市期出售了部分股份。
notable: 318,853,347 股 ICPS 到期自动转换为 79,713,321 股新股，于2026年10月29日上市。
因 ESOS 行使发行 695,000 股新股，于2026年11月18日上市。
将于2026年11月24日召开第24届常年股东大会。
risks: 独立非执行董事 MR LO LING 在闭市期出售 16,297,200 股（0.733%）。
公司持续亏损，最新季度净亏损 578 万令吉，净利率 -14.9%。
earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收 3881 万令吉，环比增长 11.4%，同比增长 4.8%；净亏损 578 万令吉，净利率 -14.9%，较上期的 -2.1% 扩大。

recent_en: AIZO Group Berhad recently completed the mandatory conversion of its ICPS upon maturity and issued new shares under its ESOS.
notable_en: 318,853,347 ICPS were automatically converted into 79,713,321 new shares upon maturity, listed on 29 Oct 2026.
695,000 new shares were issued under ESOS and listed on 18 Nov 2026.
The 24th Annual General Meeting will be held on 24 Nov 2026.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director MR LO LING disposed of 16,297,200 shares (0.733%) during the closed period.
The company remains loss-making, with a net loss of RM5.78 million and a net margin of -14.9% in the latest quarter.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM38.81 million, up 11.4% QoQ and 4.8% YoY; net loss was RM5.78 million with a net margin of -14.9%, wider than the previous -2.1%.
